title.text: CodeAI workbench shell: VS Code panes, CodeAI tokens

moved.text:
What moves where

• Session tabs → the title bar, so the session name appears once; views that do not fit move into All sessions
• Arena, Inbox, the Repository toggle, the Changes / History tabs and the toolbar's History → activity bar views
• Layout toggles → three icons: side panel, canvas, conversation. Hiding the canvas gives the conversation the width, capped at 760px for reading; the canvas and the conversation are never both hidden
• Ask / Plan / Agent → one mode picker in the composer; each choice shows its hint, and Agent keeps its wait colour
• A + attach menu: this session's diagrams and sketches, a new sketch, a headset report
• Local / Docker and Continue in Docker / Local → a line under the composer, as in VS Code's chat, with the mode's hint beside it
• More (theme, Export, VR, Build & restart, Archive) → the gear
• Notices → a row in the layout above the status bar: it shortens the columns instead of covering them (Story 62's known defect)
• Canvas toolbar row → a floating canvas bar that publishes its inset, like the zoom bar
• Bordered buttons and message cards → flat panes and 1px dividers
• The Reports icon appears only in CodeAI's own project, as the Reports tab does today; the Inbox badge counts items, as today

budget.text:
Budget at 1440×900, today's widths (side panel 340, conversation 460)

• Visible controls in the default layout: 36 by my count, against 43 after Story 62 (the canvas toggle and + attach are paid for by folding three mode buttons into one picker)
• Canvas, default layout: 932×836 against about 980×776 today, about 2.5% more area
• Canvas, both panels open: 592×836 against 640×776, about the same area
• Vertical chrome: 64px (title bar + status bar) against 124px (header + tabs + toolbar)
• The 48px activity bar moves the dock bands: 960 → 1008 and 640 → 688

server.text:
Needs the server, so not in this design (separate stories)

• Tool rows that stay in the transcript, with completion
• Queueing a second instruction during a running turn
• Diagram names
• Machine capacity ("2 of 2 slots")
• Failure detail or reply excerpts in the Inbox; Retry from the Inbox
• Searching other sessions' diagrams
• Issuing pairing codes from the browser
• Attaching a file or image from this device
• Mentioning a repository file: needs a file list; today the repository routes serve only status and diff

open.text:
Not drawn yet

• No repository: Story 62 opens the side panel on Changes, where one is attached
• Several repositories: which branch the status bar names
• Provider not ready: a status bar item, shown only then
• A second or offline machine: machine headings in the Arena view
• Widths below 688, where the panels overlay the canvas
• Focus mode, loading, an empty canvas, the diff inspector (stays in the side panel)
• Enter VR on WebXR devices: title bar, left of the layout icons
